Ugmuls 5.5e Automation · v0.7.1

New features
in the latest release.

Class features, Metamagic, and unarmed combat—with clear choices before the roll and corrections close at hand.

New in v0.7.1

More of your character.
Fewer steps to resolve it.

Bring class features, feat benefits, and Metamagic into your native D&D5e rolls. Choose the assistance your table wants from the reorganized Automations menu.

View the v0.7.1 release on GitHub ↗

Sorcerer assistance

Shape the spell.
Keep the roll connected.

  • Innate Sorcery: active Innate Sorcery recommends advantage on Sorcerer spell attacks, combining normally with disadvantage.
  • Choose before the roll: Transmuted, Heightened, and Careful Spell support single-target and area casts, with Sorcery Point costs and supported Metamagic combination limits. Heightened combines with other save conditions; Careful protects the creatures you select.
  • Empowered Spell: select individual damage dice to reroll, spend a Sorcery Point, and use the new results—even when lower.
  • Seeking Spell: reroll a d20 on a missed spell attack and refresh its hit result.
  • See what changed: Metamagic tags appear on damage cards with element and target details.

Sorcerer automation details →

Class and feat automation

The extra damage.
In the same roll.

  • Divine Smite: choose a free use or an available spell slot, consume the resource and bonus action, and automatically include the Fiend/Undead bonus.
  • Eldritch Smite: use a Pact Magic slot on a pact-weapon hit, with slot-level damage and a once-per-turn limit.
  • Hunter’s Prey: add Colossus Slayer damage against an injured target, with a remembered choice and once-per-turn tracking.
  • Frenzy: automatically add the feature damage to the first qualifying Strength-based weapon hit while Rage and Reckless Attack are active.
  • Cleaner Configuration: Yes/No selectors and live dice previews replace rider checkboxes. Savage Attacker defaults to Yes; used choices show No - Already Used.

Use the class damage riders →

Stunning Strike and Grappler

Strike, stun,
and hold.

  • Stunning Strike: spend Focus from damage Configuration and prompt the native save. Failure applies Stunned; success halves Speed and grants advantage on the next attack. Undo Effect remains available.
  • Grapple / Prone: action-based Unarmed, Empowered, and Elemental Strike hits offer independent save cards. The target uses its better Strength/Dexterity save, with Strength winning ties; Martial Arts can use Dexterity for the DC.
  • Grappler: retain damage plus Grapple once on your turn and gain advantage against creatures grappled by you. Further attempts replace damage. Grappled appears as a Temporary effect on the token HUD.
  • Resolve in order: when both are selected, Stunning Strike resolves first. A Stunned target automatically fails the following Grapple/Prone save; damage and effects then continue automatically.

Table flow and options

Find the setting.
Keep play moving.

  • Automations menu: Unique Classes, Weapon Masteries, Feats, Common, and Spells. Filter by All or a core class; navigation stays above the scrolling options. Resize the window from its bottom-right corner.
  • Combat tracking: Bonus Action and Reaction markers cover all participants; Consumed Spell Slot covers player characters. Each resets at the appropriate turn boundary and stays out of out-of-combat play.
  • Pending damage and healing: a clickable pending card lets a GM or owner reopen an unanswered prompt. Results fill the same card after animation, without duplicate Dice So Nice throws.
  • Fewer unnecessary confirmations: ordinary areas proceed after target collection. Choose Targets and applicable cast-time Metamagic still receive confirmation.
  • Corrections remain available: Undo Damage, Undo Healing, and Undo Effect support tracked applications; improved scrolling keeps expanded cards in view.

Updating from v0.7.0 keeps the same module identity and saved settings. Restart Foundry and hard-refresh connected browsers after updating.
